svg.title: Keyset Pagination
svg.desc: Keyset Pagination. Page with WHERE key > last seen instead of OFFSET, so page 1,000 is as fast as page 1 and no row repeats or goes missing. Step 1, OFFSET reads, then drops: Page 1,000 with OFFSET 49950: the index scan fetches 50,000 rows and Limit keeps only the last 50. Step 2, Rows shift between loads: A new order between two loads pushes every row down one: OFFSET 50 repeats 499955, keyset doesn't. Step 3, Seek past the last key: Keyset seeks past the last key: 3 index pages and 50 rows, so page 1,000 costs what page 1 does. Step 4, Limits and other engines: No jump to page 734, a total is a full count, each filter needs its index; DynamoDB seeks too.

g.text: Page 1,000 with OFFSET 49950: the index scan fetches 50,000 rows and Limit keeps only the last 50.
A new order between two loads pushes every row down one: OFFSET 50 repeats 499955, keyset doesn't.
Keyset seeks past the last key: 3 index pages and 50 rows, so page 1,000 costs what page 1 does.
No jump to page 734, a total is a full count, each filter needs its index; DynamoDB seeks too.
SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 50 OFFSET 49950
SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 50 OFFSET 0
SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 50 OFFSET 50
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE (created_at, id) < ($1, $2) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 50
#4,951 · page 100 would start here, in leaf 1905
49,950 rows fetched, then dropped by Limit
never read: the cursor jumps over them
page 734 starts at #36,651: which key is that?
Orders · newest first · 50 per page · 10,000 pages
rows to skip: the database still reads every one of them
sorts first: all rows move down 1
its first key is unknown until
offer Next / Previous, or a date
29 ms each time. For a Next link,
200 OK · 50 orders, 450045 … 449996 · next_cursor = the key of 449996
two orders may share a created_at;
adding id makes every key unique
